subject: general
question: From the given options, which country has the largest deposit of mica in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is** India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **distinctive physical property of micas**, a type of silicate mineral, is their ease in splitting into incredibly thin elastic plates.
 
• **Mica are dielectric, insulating, and heat-tolerant**. They are utilized in electrical equipment as a result of these qualities.
 
• One of the world's top producers and exporters of mica is India. It is mostly produced in** Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, and Maharashtra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​**

 
• **India's major producer of mica is Andhra Pradesh**. India had a monopoly on the manufacturing and export of sheet mica around the world for more than a century.
 
• The two countries that export sheet mica the most internationally are** India and Madagascar**, with the majority of the mica being mined in unauthorised mines.
 
• The** Andhra Pradesh state's Nellore mica belt** is the biggest and most significant producer in the nation.
